description: Get a blob's raw bytes by owning DID and CID. Unauthenticated, like upstream ATProto: the CID is the capability — it is published only inside records, which is where membership gating lives.

did.description: DID of the repo that references the blob.

cid.description: CID of the blob (CIDv1, raw codec).

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: No blob with this CID is owned by this DID.
